top_violation_types.title: Ammunition Kept Separate, Locked and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3505(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Ammunition continues to not be locked separate from the firearms. Per the provider, both the firearms and the ammunition were locked together in the same safe.

top_violation_types.title: Water Temperature (26 TAC §747.3219)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The hot water temperature for the restroom used by children exceeded 120 degrees.

top_violation_types.title: Must Have at Least One 3A-40BC Dry Chemical Fire Extinguisher or Fire Extinguisher Approved by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §747.5103)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed to have a fire extinguisher 1A-10 BC instead of the required 3A-40BC fire extinguisher.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not Licensed (26 TAC §HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not L)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is operating prior to receiving their permit.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §747.613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Of the four children's records evaluated, one was behind with required immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.801(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two cats and two dogs do not have up to date vaccinations.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.
